content.question: Why is the word 'bank' a problem for static embeddings like word2vec and GloVe?
options: Because static embeddings are too small to encode rare words
Because each word type has a single vector, so both of its senses - river bank and financial institution - collapse into one representation
Because 'bank' cannot be represented as character n-grams
Because static embeddings cannot be evaluated on analogy tasks
content.answer: Because each word type has a single vector, so both of its senses - river bank and financial institution - collapse into one representation
